document.name: Rocking the Boat Summer Camp
document.shortDescription: Weeklong Hunts Point summer camp on the Bronx River for rising 4th-9th graders, with woodworking, river ecology, rowing, and mini-camps.
document.longDescription:
Rocking the Boat's official summer camp page invites rising 4th through 9th graders to spend the summer in Hunts Point exploring the Bronx River through woodworking, rowing, and river ecology. The page says camp runs June 22 through September 9, 2026, with elementary and middle school weeklong sessions plus holiday-week mini-camps.

The published schedule is Monday-Friday from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Rocking the Boat lists pricing at $450 per camper per week, with mini-camps at $90 per day, and notes that no previous experience is necessary. The site says all swim abilities are welcome and that children wear US Coast Guard approved life jackets while on or near the water.

The organization lists its Hunts Point address as 812 Edgewater Road, Bronx, NY 10474, with contact email publicprograms@rockingtheboat.org for camp questions and main phone 718-466-5799.

Sources: https://rockingtheboat.org/public-programs/camp https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/53155310413_a9646537b4_h.jpg
